name: Galaxy Backbone National Shared Services Centre (NSSC) Abuja
notes: Official Galaxy Backbone FAQ confirms an Uptime Institute Tier III data centre in Abuja (Tier IV in Kano, outside this batch). Guardian (2026) reports the only Uptime Tier III public-sector DC at ~38% utilisation of ~2.5 MW capacity; Nairametrics (2024) cites ~128 rack spaces scalable to 512 (2019 build). Capacity_mw 2.5 is a press-reported figure (B-grade estimate); facility existence is A-grade via operator official page and Uptime. Hosts federal shared services; do not duplicate GBB hosted-state partnerships as new facilities elsewhere.

name: Kasi Cloud DNEK campus (Eket)
notes: Official Kasi Cloud site lists DNEK Campus 'Coming Soon' in Eket, Akwa Ibom (planned DNEK1/DNEK2 campuses per press); sister LOS1 campus in Lekki, Lagos (100 MW AI-ready, first phase operational 2026) is outside this division. No DNEK capacity, permit, or construction evidence disclosed - status planned/announced. Grade A for official plan existence; treat 2026 operational claims as needing primary confirmation.

name: UniCloud Africa / Benue Digital Infrastructure Company (BDIC) data centre, Makurdi
developer: UniCloud Africa + Benue Digital Infrastructure Company (state-run); Cedarview Communication, SIT Consulting partners
notes: DCD (2024-07-12): MoU between UniCloud Africa and BDIC to build a data centre in Makurdi, est. cost 10.8bn naira (~US$6.6m) with ~6-month build; Africa Data Centres to provide a complementary Abuja DR site. MoU/announced stage only - no permit, site, or construction evidence found; per methodology do not upgrade to operational without procurement/site/commissioning proof.

name: Benue State / Galaxy Backbone state-owned data centre agreement
developer: Benue State Government with Galaxy Backbone Ltd
notes: Trade press reports a Benue State-Galaxy Backbone agreement for ~80% fibre coverage and Nigeria's 'first state-owned data center' managed by GBB for disaster recovery. Agreement-level lead with no named physical site/parcel/construction; per NG methodology do not treat GBB hosted-service partnerships as new state facilities unless a physical build is named. Status planned/announced.

name: Nugi Group Tier 4 data centre, Calabar
notes: Punch (2025-09-30): Nugi Group plans a Tier 4 data centre in Calabar; land reportedly secured near a waterfall for hydroelectric generation, plus solar storage and natural gas options. Announcement/plan stage only - no EIA, permit, NERC power record, or construction evidence found; capacity not disclosed. Grade B (reputable local business press), lead-level per methodology.

name: Green Flare flare-gas Bitcoin mining data centres (3 sites)
notes: DCD (2025-06-02): Green Flare announced a 53 MW data centre programme for Bitcoin mining powered by flare gas, starting with three mining sites in Delta State totalling 53 MW. Crypto-mining data centres (not commercial colocation); announcement stage, no construction/permits confirmed. Capacity 53 MW is the announced site-load figure from trade press.

name: Medallion Communications Asaba data centre
notes: Jan 2020 trade-press claim that Medallion's Asaba data centre would be operational by end-Q1 2020 as part of a two-DC-per-state advocacy. Single weak source, not corroborated by current operator/official pages (Medallion assets later rebranded under Digital Realty with Lagos/Victoria Island focus); current status unverified - record as unverified lead, not an operational facility.
